technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with extreme overbought RSI and volume spike, but weak trend structure (low ADX, below 200-MA) and intermediate resistance create pullback risk; suitable for tactical entry with tight stops.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed AAII sentiment (bearish 33% vs bullish 31%) with neutral fear-greed reading (57/100) provides no clear directional bias; insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (194.7) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 13 days adds binary event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI overbought (89.67) with 15x volume spike and Awesome Oscillator bullish cross suggest capitulation-driven momentum that could push through 93.46 resistance if institutional buyers step in.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely hostile (VIX crisis at 194.7, inverted yield curve, earnings binary event in 13 days), price is below 200-MA/50-SMA, ADX is weak (12.07), and overbought extremes typically precede pullbacks to 90.50 support—risk/reward is unfavorable.
